items.title: Supreme Court Questions Two-Child Norm Citing Decline in India's Total Fertility Rate
items.summary: The Supreme Court noted that India's total fertility rate has fallen from 3 to 1.9, which is below the replacement rate of 2.1. In light of this decline, the Court questioned the validity of maintaining a two-child norm.

items.title: IndiaAI Mission Releases Indigenous AI Models EKA-1, Dhīr 2B, and Dhīr 5B
items.summary: The IndiaAI Mission has released three indigenous foundation models, namely EKA-1, Dhīr 2B, and Dhīr 5B. This marks a significant milestone in advancing homegrown artificial intelligence technology in India.

items.title: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu Wins India's First Youth Olympic Wushu Medal
items.summary: Rajkumari Lanchenbi Chanu has won India's first Youth Olympic medal in Wushu.

items.title: NTPC Targets 149 GW Installed Capacity by 2032
items.summary: NTPC has set a target to reach an installed capacity of 149 GW by the year 2032.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules ECI in Error Over Form 6 Requirement for Excluded Voters
items.summary: The Supreme Court clarified that the ECI erred in forcing pre-existing voters deleted from electoral rolls to reapply as new voters under Form 6 of the Registration of Electors Rules, 1960.

items.title: Union Cabinet to Discuss Capex Support for Critical Mineral Processing and VGF for Renewable Energy Storage
items.summary: The Union Cabinet is set to discuss capital expenditure support of approximately 30% for establishing critical mineral processing plants. The proposal also includes Viability Gap Funding (VGF) for grid-scale renewable energy storage systems.

items.title: Strategic Context of IRNSS and NavIC Development
items.summary: The concept of India's IRNSS (NavIC) system originated from a strategic necessity after the United States denied access to its Global Positioning Service (GPS) during the 1999 Kargil conflict.

items.title: Hakeem Jeffries Set to Become First Black Speaker of U.S. House of Representatives
items.summary: Hakeem Jeffries, representing a New York City congressional district, is positioned to become the first Black Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives. He will preside over the House majority starting in the first week of January, taking over leadership from the Republicans.

items.title: Bhutan Sets Guinness World Record by Raising 108 Stupas in 9 Hours
items.summary: Bhutan set a Guinness World Record by raising 108 stupas in nine hours with the help of around 40,000 trained volunteers. The achievement aims to lay the spiritual foundation for the country's proposed Gelephu Mindfulness City.

items.title: ICJ to Rule on Gambia's Rohingya Genocide Case Against Myanmar
items.summary: The International Court of Justice will issue its ruling on November 19 regarding The Gambia's case against Myanmar. The case accuses Myanmar of breaching the 1948 UN Genocide Convention during its repression of the Rohingya population.

items.title: Delhi Imposes GRAP Stage 2 Restrictions as AQI Reaches Very Poor Category
items.summary: Delhi has implemented Stage 2 of the Graded Response Action Plan (GRAP) after the Air Quality Index (AQI) worsened to the 'very poor' category. The measures include imposing bans on older vehicles, increasing parking fees, and promoting the use of public transport.

items.title: NITI Aayog Launches India S&T Scoreboard
items.summary: NITI Aayog has launched the India S&T Scoreboard initiative.

items.title: IndiaAI Mission Unveils EKA-1 and Dhīr Foundation Models
items.summary: The IndiaAI Mission has unveiled the EKA-1 and Dhīr foundation models.

items.title: NPPA Updates Reduced Prices for 1,085 Anti-Cancer Medicines
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has updated reduced prices for 1,085 anti-cancer medicines.

items.title: SEBI Partners with BHASHINI to Expand Regional-Language Services
items.summary: SEBI has partnered with BHASHINI to expand its regional-language services.

items.title: Panchayati Raj Ministry Proposes Linking Welfare Payments to Voter IDs
items.summary: The Panchayati Raj Minister stated that welfare payments will be linked to voter IDs (EPIC numbers) along with biometrics. Welfare payments are currently linked to Aadhaar.

items.title: MEA Reaffirms Structured Mechanism for Ganga Water Treaty Ahead of Expiry
items.summary: The Ministry of External Affairs affirmed that a structured mechanism remains in place for the Ganga Water Treaty between India and Bangladesh. The spokesperson also confirmed an invitation to the Bangladesh Prime Minister to visit New Delhi.

items.title: Tanvi Patri Becomes First Indian Badminton Player to Reach Youth Olympic Final
items.summary: Fifteen-year-old Tanvi Patri from Odisha became the first Indian badminton player to qualify for the Youth Olympic badminton final. She achieved the feat after defeating Japan's second seed Yuzuno Watanabe in the semifinals.

items.title: ISRO's NVS-03 Satellite Successfully Reaches Geosynchronous Orbit
items.summary: ISRO announced that the NVS-03 satellite has reached Geosynchronous Orbit at an inclination of 29.98 degrees. The orbit placement was accomplished following four successful manoeuvres with a cumulative LAM engine burn of 6,164 seconds.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves VISTAR Scheme to Overhaul India's Statistical System
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved the VISTAR scheme aimed at modernising India's statistical infrastructure. The three-pronged initiative will integrate AI, improve data collection, and capture unorganised sector data to enhance GDP calculation accuracy.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves ₹14,500 Crore Viability Gap Funding Scheme for Energy Storage
items.summary: The Union Cabinet approved a Viability Gap Funding (VGF) scheme worth ₹14,500 crore to advance large-scale energy storage capacity in India. It supports hydro pumped storage plants, battery energy storage systems, and alternative storage technologies.

items.title: India Plans World’s Highest Railway Station at Tanglang La
items.summary: India is planning to build the world's highest railway station at Tanglang La.

items.title: Cabinet Approves ₹2,814 Crore Critical Mineral Processing Scheme
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the Critical Mineral Processing Scheme with a budget of ₹2,814 crore.

items.title: Cabinet Approves ₹14,500-Crore Energy Storage VGF Scheme
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved the Energy Storage Viability Gap Funding (VGF) Scheme with an outlay of ₹14,500 crore.

items.title: Over 43 Lakh Pucca Houses Completed in Bihar Under PMAY-G
items.summary: More than 43 lakh pucca houses have been completed for poor families in Bihar under the Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G). A total of ₹56,743.40 crore has been spent under the scheme in the state, with 36.63 lakh houses constructed between FY 2016-17 and FY 2021-22.

items.title: Amish Shah Becomes First Indian-American to Represent Arizona in U.S. Congress
items.summary: Amish Shah has created history by becoming the first Indian-American to represent Arizona in the U.S. Congress after winning his seat. He has also become the sixth Indian-American member elected to the U.S. House of Representatives.

items.title: Centre Earmarks ₹2,814 Crore for Domestic Lithium and Nickel Processing
items.summary: Union Coal and Mines Minister G. Kishan Reddy announced an allocation of ₹2,814 crore to enhance domestic lithium and nickel processing. The initiative seeks to strengthen manufacturing capabilities and decrease dependence on foreign imports.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules Adjudication Unnecessary in Sales Tax Case Due to GST Implementation
items.summary: A seven-judge Supreme Court bench led by CJI Surya Kant held that the reference regarding states' power to levy additional sales tax under the Orissa Sales Tax Act no longer requires adjudication. The court noted that challenged provisions have been amended and GST now governs the matter.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules 24-Hour Production Before Magistrate Starts From Detention, Not Formal Arrest
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that the mandatory 24-hour period to produce an arrested individual before a magistrate begins from the time of actual detention rather than formal arrest. The Court stated that fundamental rights override restrictions even under special laws such as UAPA and PMLA.

items.title: Nirmala Lakshman's Book 'The Tamils : A Portrait of a Community' Wins Sharjah Award
items.summary: Author Nirmala Lakshman's book 'The Tamils : A Portrait of a Community', published by Aleph Book Company, has won the Sharjah award.

items.title: Union Cabinet Approves Changes to Agniveer Scheme for Absorption Pathway
items.summary: The Union Cabinet has approved changes to the Agniveer scheme based on recommendations from the three services. The decision creates a pathway for the absorption of willing Agniveers subject to merit and prescribed selection criteria.

items.title: AERB Affirms Safety Standards for Private Sector Entry in Nuclear Energy
items.summary: The Atomic Energy Regulatory Board (AERB) Chairperson stated that safety aspects will not be compromised despite the Union government's policy decision to allow private sector entry into nuclear energy. The statement comes in the context of the proposed SHANTI Act and policy shifts toward private participation.

items.title: Protests Continue Against ₹76,220-Crore Vadhavan Port Project in Palghar
items.summary: Local villagers and opposition parties in Palghar continue to oppose the ₹76,220-crore Vadhavan port project over concerns regarding their land, marine resources, and future livelihoods.

items.title: Supreme Court Observes Two-Child Penalty Laws Outdated Amid Falling Fertility Rates
items.summary: A Supreme Court Bench observed that statutory two-child penalties have become outdated because the fear of overpopulation has crumbled due to demographic changes. The Court noted that declining fertility rates over recent decades make such restrictive measures obsolete.

items.title: Satellite Study Shows 73% Reduction in Bhutan's Sintaphu Tsho Lake After GLOF
items.summary: A geospatial satellite assessment revealed a 73% reduction in the size of Bhutan's Sintaphu Tsho lake following a Glacial Lake Outburst Flood (GLOF). The study also noted that a supraglacial lake adjoining Sintaphu Tsho continues to remain substantially larger than its 2016 extent.

items.title: Ukrainian President Confers State Honour 'Order of Princess Olga' on U.S. First Lady
items.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy awarded the Order of Princess Olga, 1st class, to U.S. First Lady Melania Trump. The state honour recognizes women who have made exceptional contributions in fields including science, education, culture, and charitable work.

items.title: S. Jaishankar Emphasises Digital Public Infrastructure at Commonwealth Meeting
items.summary: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar highlighted the importance of digital public infrastructure at the Commonwealth meeting held in Antigua and Barbuda. He also addressed India's ongoing negotiations and recent Free Trade Agreements.

items.title: Tamil Nadu Sanctions ₹1.3 Crore for Bengal Fox and Golden Jackal Conservation
items.summary: The Tamil Nadu state government has sanctioned ₹1.3 crore for a comprehensive assessment of habitat use, threats, and distribution patterns of the Bengal fox and golden jackal. The initiative aims to build a long-term conservation roadmap for the species.

items.title: 4th Mining Ministers' Conference to be Held in Goa
items.summary: The 4th Conference of Mining Ministers is scheduled to take place in Goa on November 5–6, 2026.

items.title: JNCASR Develops Silicon Chip for Terahertz 6G Communication
items.summary: JNCASR has developed a silicon chip designed for Terahertz 6G communication.

items.title: India and Guyana Extend $500 Million Line of Credit
items.summary: India and Guyana have extended a Line of Credit worth $500 million.

items.title: Tanvi Patri Becomes First Indian Woman to Reach Youth Olympics Semifinals
items.summary: Tanvi Patri has become the first Indian woman to reach the semifinals at the Youth Olympics.

items.title: Harmanpreet Singh Scores 250th International Goal
items.summary: Harmanpreet Singh has achieved the milestone of scoring his 250th international goal.

items.title: TRAI Launches Network Anubhav Platform
items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has launched the Network Anubhav platform.

items.title: Supreme Court Settles Decades-Old Energy Dispute for Himachal Pradesh
items.summary: The Supreme Court has resolved a decades-old energy dispute by directing Punjab and Haryana to supply 11,973 million units of electricity to Himachal Pradesh over a 20-year period.

items.title: India Calls for Accountability for Attacks on UN Peacekeepers
items.summary: India demanded at the United Nations that perpetrators of attacks against UN Peacekeepers (Blue Helmets) must be held accountable. India highlighted its status as one of the largest troop contributors, having deployed over 3,00,000 troops across 50 missions.

items.title: Mahabharata, Arthashastra, and Rajatarangini Added to UNESCO Regional Memory Register
items.summary: Manuscripts of the Mahabharata, Arthashastra, and Rajatarangini have been inscribed on UNESCO's Memory of the World regional register. Union Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat recognized the event as a landmark milestone for India's documentary heritage.

items.title: Bhagavad Gita and Natyashastra Manuscripts Inscribed on UNESCO Memory of the World Register
items.summary: Manuscripts of the Bhagavad Gita and Natyashastra were officially inscribed on UNESCO's Memory of the World Register. A total of 74 new documentary heritage collections were added to the register as of April 17, 2025.

items.title: India's 'Maratha Military Landscapes' Inscribed on UNESCO World Heritage List
items.summary: The 'Maratha Military Landscapes' of India have been added to the UNESCO World Heritage List. The listing features 12 components, including 11 forts located in Maharashtra and Gingee Fort in Tamil Nadu.

items.title: ISRO Confirms NVS-03 Navigation Satellite Healthy for NavIC Payload Testing
items.summary: ISRO Chairman V. Narayanan announced that the NVS-03 navigation satellite is fully healthy, with in-orbit testing scheduled for its payload as part of the operationalization of NavIC, India's indigenous GPS alternative.

items.title: India Announces $500 Million Line of Credit Extension for Guyana
items.summary: India has announced the extension of a $500 million line of credit to Guyana following a meeting between External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar and Guyanese President Mohamed Irfaan Ali on the sidelines of the Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo Retires from Portuguese National Football Team
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from the Portuguese national football team. He leaves international football having made 234 appearances and scored 146 goals for Portugal.

items.title: Indian NGO REACH Awarded Kochon Prize 2026 for Fight Against TB
items.summary: Indian NGO REACH has received the Kochon Prize 2026 for making significant contributions to the fight against tuberculosis. The award is presented by the Korean non-profit Kochon Foundation in partnership with the Stop TB Partnership.

items.title: India’s First Private Space Debris Recovery Facility Opens in Hyderabad
items.summary: A Hyderabad startup has launched India’s first private space debris recovery facility to tackle risks from orbiting space junk. Out of roughly 28,000 satellites currently in orbit, around 10,000 are non-operational.

items.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Non-Retrospective Application of OBC Creamy Layer Verdict
items.summary: The Supreme Court clarified that its March 2026 judgment regarding the OBC creamy layer policy will not apply retrospectively. It noted that service allocation for the 2025 batch will remain in compliance with the March 2026 judgment.

items.title: Paraguay President Santiago Peña Steps Down Amid Banking Crisis
items.summary: Paraguay President Santiago Peña has stepped down from office following widespread protests outside Congress triggered by a severe banking crisis.

items.title: Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri Visits Nepal Ahead of PM's Visit
items.summary: Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri visited Nepal to set the stage for the Nepali Prime Minister's upcoming visit to India. Nepali leaders expressed appreciation for India's swift humanitarian and technical assistance after the Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Mines Ministry Launches 9th Round of Critical Mineral Block Auctions
items.summary: The Ministry of Mines has launched the ninth tranche of auctions offering 20 critical mineral blocks. Across all tranches to date, 100 unique critical and strategic mineral blocks have been offered, of which 64 have been successfully auctioned.

items.title: India Targets 3% CBG Blending into PNG and CNG by End of Current Fiscal
items.summary: India achieved a 1.7% Compressed Bio-Gas (CBG) blending rate in H1, with official targets set at 3% by the end of the current fiscal year, 4% in 2027-28, and 5% in the subsequent year.

items.title: Tanvi Patri Wins Silver Medal at Youth Olympics
items.summary: 15-year-old Indian athlete Tanvi Patri secured a silver medal at the Youth Olympics following an hour-and-22-minute summit clash where she saved six match points.

items.title: India Retains Asian Champions Trophy Title
items.summary: India successfully retained the Asian Champions Trophy title by defeating Japan in the final match. Malaysia finished in third place in the tournament.

items.title: Bay of Bengal Countries Launch Fisheries Research Network
items.summary: Countries in the Bay of Bengal region have launched a dedicated Fisheries Research Network.

items.title: Asteroid 2026 QQ8 Becomes Earth’s Temporary Mini-Moon
items.summary: Asteroid 2026 QQ8 has temporarily entered Earth's gravitational influence to become a mini-moon.

items.title: New Six-Foot Flowering Plant Discovered in Assam and Meghalaya
items.summary: A new six-foot tall flowering plant species has been discovered in the states of Assam and Meghalaya.

items.title: Nirmala Lakshman’s Book Wins Sharjah Award
items.summary: Author Nirmala Lakshman has won the Sharjah Award for her book.

items.title: India and Canada Hold Inaugural Defence Dialogue
items.summary: India and Canada have conducted their inaugural Defence Dialogue to strengthen bilateral military cooperation.

items.title: Government Approves 12 Electronics Components Proposals Worth ₹7,503 Crore
items.summary: The Union Government has approved 12 proposals related to electronics components manufacturing with a total financial commitment of ₹7,503 crore.

items.title: India and EU conclude strategic Horizon global innovation programme
items.summary: India and the European Union have concluded a multi-billion Euro global innovation programme named Horizon. The association forms a key part of the five-year comprehensive strategic agenda between both sides.

items.title: TRAI Proposes Authorisation Framework for Satellite Network Providers
items.summary: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) has submitted proposals regarding authorisation for satellite network providers.

items.title: ₹2,000-Crore Allocation Ordered for Vetri Laptop Scheme
items.summary: An allocation of ₹2,000 crore has been ordered to implement the Vetri Laptop Scheme, benefiting first- and second-year undergraduate and diploma students in government and government-aided colleges for the 2026-2027 academic year.

items.title: Vice President Confers Dr. Rajendra Prasad Award for Academic Excellence on Prof. K. Chockalingam
items.summary: The Vice President conferred the Dr. Rajendra Prasad Award for Academic Excellence on Professor K. Chockalingam. The honour recognizes his academic career spanning over five decades and his pioneering work in criminology and victimology.

items.title: Sonia Gandhi's memoir 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' set for release
items.summary: Former Congress leader Sonia Gandhi's upcoming memoir titled 'Belonging: A Journey of Love' is scheduled for release on November 10. The book is published domestically by HarperCollins India.

items.title: Assam bans drone operations near Amur falcon roosting sites
items.summary: The Assam government has prohibited drone operations near the roosting sites of Amur falcons to protect the migratory raptors. The restriction was imposed after visitors and content creators flew drones close to bird congregations for social media footage.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules Temporary Silk Cotton Cultivators Ineligible for Protection Under FRA Act
items.summary: The Supreme Court directed that temporary and non-resident silk cotton cultivators are not eligible for protection under the Forest Rights Act (FRA). The directive was issued in connection with the Agasthyamalai conservation case.

items.title: Climate Scientist P.V. Joseph Passes Away
items.summary: Climate scientist P.V. Joseph, who discovered the low-level monsoon jetstream, has passed away. He conducted extensive research on monsoon onset, Rossby waves, and ocean-atmosphere instability.

items.title: Supreme Court Settles Dispute Over Himachal Pradesh Share in BBMB Power Projects
items.summary: The Supreme Court settled a decades-old dispute concerning Himachal Pradesh's 7.19% share in the power generated from Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) projects.

items.title: Abdul El-Sayed Becomes First Muslim Elected to the US Senate
items.summary: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed made history by becoming the first Muslim elected to the United States Senate. He secured victory over Republican Mike Rogers during the 2026 midterm elections.

items.title: Centre Mandates Rice and Paddy Stock Declaration to Prevent Hoarding
items.summary: The Union government has mandated stock declarations for rice and paddy to prevent hoarding amidst rising prices. Additionally, five southern States have been permitted to impose stock limits.

items.title: ADNOC Signs 10-Year LNG Supply Deal with Gujarat Energy
items.summary: Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC) has executed a 10-year LNG supply and purchase agreement with Gujarat Energy. This marks the fifth long-term LNG agreement signed by ADNOC with India.

items.title: ICAR-CMFRI Study Records Expansion in Kerala's Mangrove Cover
items.summary: A study conducted by the ICAR-Central Marine Fisheries Research Institute in Kochi revealed an expansion in Kerala's coastal mangrove vegetation over the past decade. The research analyzed and compared satellite imagery from 2017 and 2026.

items.title: Mohammed Shami Retires from Test Cricket
items.summary: Indian fast bowler Mohammed Shami has announced his retirement from Test cricket. He concluded his Test career with 229 wickets from 64 matches and will continue to play in white-ball formats.

items.title: UNESCO Adds Three Indian Manuscripts to Asia-Pacific Register
items.summary: UNESCO has officially included three Indian manuscripts in its Asia-Pacific Regional Register.

items.title: Supreme Court Rules 24-Hour Arrest Clock Starts from Actual Detention
items.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that the mandatory 24-hour arrest clock for a detained person begins from the moment of actual detention.

items.title: India and EU Conclude Horizon Europe Association Talks
items.summary: India and the European Union have concluded negotiations regarding India's association with the Horizon Europe research initiative.

items.title: France Honours Narayana Health Founder Devi Shetty
items.summary: France has conferred an honour upon Narayana Health founder Dr. Devi Shetty.

items.title: FSSAI conducts nationwide enforcement drive, seizes 3,280 tonnes of food items
items.summary: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) inspected 56,431 food establishments during a nationwide enforcement drive from September 1 to November 5. During the drive, the regulator seized 3,280 tonnes of non-compliant food products and cancelled 52 licences.

items.title: Bihar Museum ranked among the best in the world by German publication
items.summary: A German publication has ranked the Bihar Museum among the best museums in the world. The museum is recognized for its contribution to showcasing the development of Indian civilization.

items.title: Defence Minister reviews LAC infrastructure and military readiness near China frontier
items.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed military personnel at an airbase near the China frontier and called for high military readiness to face evolving threats. He also reviewed the Indian Army's operational preparedness and infrastructure along the Line of Actual Control.

items.title: East Bengal Becomes First Indian Club to Reach AFC Women's Champions League Knockout Stage
items.summary: East Bengal became the first Indian club to advance to the knockout stage of the AFC Women's Champions League. The Kolkata-based team created history by qualifying for the elimination rounds of the elite competition.

items.title: Adkar and Bhosale Become First All-Indian Pair to Reach WTA Tour Doubles Final
items.summary: The pair of Adkar and Bhosale became the first all-Indian team to reach a doubles final at the main WTA Tour level. Previously, no all-Indian combination had achieved a final appearance at this level in women's tennis.

items.title: Nivetha Wins AFC Youth Female Coach of the Year Award
items.summary: Nivetha has been honoured with the AFC Youth Female Coach of the Year Award.

items.title: Mohammed Shami Announces Retirement from Test Cricket
items.summary: Indian fast bowler Mohammed Shami has officially retired from Test cricket.

items.title: Lt Gen Sushil Chander Mahant Appointed as Army DGIT
items.summary: Lieutenant General Sushil Chander Mahant has taken charge as the Director General of Information Technology (DGIT) of the Indian Army.

items.title: Pedro Alliana Sworn In as President of Paraguay
items.summary: Pedro Alliana has officially taken office as the President of Paraguay.

items.title: Anuj Shrivatri Becomes India’s 100th Chess Grandmaster
items.summary: Twenty-two-year-old Anuj Shrivatri became India’s 100th chess Grandmaster after winning the 7th ASEAN+ Individual Open chess championship in Ozamiz City, the Philippines.

items.title: COP31 Climate Conference Opens in Antalya
items.summary: The COP31 international climate conference has opened in the Mediterranean seaside city of Antalya, with over 100,000 participants expected to attend amid growing climate and geopolitical pressures.

items.title: Parliament’s Monsoon Session Remains Unprorogued for Record 88 Days
items.summary: Neither the Lok Sabha nor the Rajya Sabha was formally prorogued for a record 88 days following the Monsoon Session, leaving open the possibility of an extended sitting.

items.title: Modernist Artist Arpita Singh Passes Away at 89
items.summary: Renowned modernist artist Arpita Singh has passed away at the age of 89. She was honored with the Padma Bhushan in 2011 and the Lalit Kala Akademi Fellowship in 2014 for her significant contributions to art.

items.title: 19 Indian Seafarers Stranded in Yemen Evacuated
items.summary: Nineteen Indian seafarers who were stranded in Yemen have been evacuated. This evacuation follows the confirmation of safety for 14 Indian nationals involved in a yacht incident off the coast of Yemen.

items.title: G7 Ministers Gather to Discuss Ukraine Conflict and Iran War
items.summary: Ministers from the G7 leading industrialised nations—Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, and the United States—have met to address efforts aimed at ending the Ukraine conflict and halting a new war involving Iran.

items.title: Vaishnavi and Rutuja Become First All-Indian Pair to Reach WTA Tour Final
items.summary: Indian tennis players Vaishnavi and Rutuja finished as runners-up in the doubles final of the WTA Chennai Open against a Swiss pair. They achieved a historic milestone by becoming the first-ever all-Indian pair to reach the final of a WTA Tour event.

items.title: Ashwini Vaishnaw Launches Semicon India 2.0 Portal
items.summary: Union Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw launched the Semicon India 2.0 Portal to further advance India's semiconductor initiatives.

items.title: Scientists Identify 4.1-Billion-Year-Old Martian Meteorite
items.summary: Scientists have identified a Martian meteorite determined to be 4.1 billion years old.

items.title: U.K. Writer M. John Harrison Wins Booker Prize
items.summary: U.K. writer M. John Harrison, aged 81, has won the Booker Prize for his AI-tinged apocalyptic novel, becoming the oldest recipient of the award. The honor includes a prize of £50,000 ($67,000).

items.title: Social Activist Sanjit Bunker Roy Passes Away
items.summary: Renowned social activist Sanjit 'Bunker' Roy has passed away. He was the founder of the Social Work and Research Centre, popularly known as Barefoot College, established in Tilonia in 1972.

items.title: CSIR-CCMB Identifies Potential New Targets to Fight Tuberculosis
items.summary: A team of researchers at CSIR-CCMB has identified potential new targets to combat Tuberculosis. The development aims to address the public health challenge posed by the emergence of drug-resistant strains of the disease.

items.title: China's Trade Surplus Surpasses $1 Trillion Mark
items.summary: China announced that its trade surplus surpassed $1 trillion in October, supported by strong global demand for artificial intelligence-related products. Exports were boosted by items including computer chips, data centre servers, and networking equipment.

items.title: Global Carbon Dioxide Emissions Decrease by 0.4% in 2026
items.summary: According to scientists from the Global Carbon Project, global emissions of heat-trapping carbon dioxide from fossil fuel burning totaled 42.2 billion tonnes in 2026. This reflects a 0.4% decrease compared to the previous year.

items.title: Anuj Shrivatri Becomes India's 100th Chess Grandmaster
items.summary: Anuj Shrivatri became India's 100th Chess Grandmaster by winning the ASEAN Plus Individual Open Chess Championship. He secured the GM title directly at the event held in Ozamiz City, the Philippines.

items.summary: Justice Murali Purushothaman sets aside notice by police authorities banning the hotel from operating and conducting DJ parties after 11 p.m.

items.summary: Chennai recorded liquor sales worth ₹95.85 crore, while the Tiruchi zone clocked ₹98.97 crore, followed by Madurai at ₹88.38 crore

items.summary: The chips company CEO is at the center of a controversy over whether he drove sales of advanced computer chips to China, in spite of U.S. tech restrictions aimed at limiting China’s ability to access these advanced technologies

items.summary: The UN chief statement came as the UN’s World Meteorological Organization released a report indicating that 2026 has continued a streak of exceptional global temperatures, melting ice and rising sea levels

items.summary: Enumeration covers only 2,211.73 of the 6,748.52 hectares of horticultural crops damaged by Cyclone Murasu

items.title: Dhaka wants Hasina extradited under prisoner exchange
items.summary: Hasina seeks fresh passport, but Minister Humayun Kabir calls ousted leader a “terrorist” and dismisses request; no response from MEA, sources say denial of passport may complicate matter if India were to extradite Hasina

items.title: Nvidia plunges but tech shares rebound, oil prices slump
items.summary: Nvidia shares slumped more than 8% as trading got under way in New York but recovered to stand down more than 5% in early afternoon trading

items.title: Trump’s close ties to Nvidia’s Huang scrutinised after foreign intelligence concerns
items.summary: Mr. Huang is one of Mr. Trump’s closest allies in Silicon Valley

items.title: Hegseth faces expected U.S. House impeachment vote this week
items.summary: U.S. Representative Thomas Massie, a Kentucky Republican, introduced articles of impeachment on Monday, setting off a two-day ‌clock for an expected House vote on charges including waging war against Iran without congressional approval and other abuses of power

items.title: Ahead of Abu Dhabi peace talks, Modi speaks to Zelenskyy; Jaishankar speaks to Lavrov
items.summary: India is ready to mediate to establish grain safety agreement for “food corridors”, says Ukrainian President Zelenskyy

items.title: Man arrested after crashing car into park across from White House
items.summary: The driver of the vehicle was ‘quickly placed under arrest’ after he ‘became combative with law enforcement’, a U.S. Secret Service spokesperson said

items.title: Trump says likely to meet Putin, Xi at China APEC summit
items.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump indicated to reporters that a deal on the Russia-Ukraine war, the Iran issue and nuclear arms control would be on the agenda

items.title: Trump to meet Iran war mediator Qatar, no imminent deal seen to end war
items.summary: Mutual attacks continue, with the U.S. striking Iran's Qeshm island overnight, according to Iranian state media, and Iran attacking tankers in the Gulf and ‌Strait of Hormuz this month while its Yemeni Houthi allies have hit Saudi Arabia
